parameters.name: ClusterIds
parameters.description: JSON格式的字符串，可以被解析为一个字符串数组。要删除策略规则的关联集群数组。

example.unifiedCli: aliyun adcp delete-policy-instance --cluster-id c09946603cd764dac96135f51d1ba0000 --policy-name ACKNoEnvVarSecrets --cluster-ids c1c731554c1ec4a1ca9bb690ff9ed0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun adcp DeletePolicyInstance --region cn-hangzhou --ClusterId c09946603cd764dac96135f51d1ba0000 --PolicyName ACKNoEnvVarSecrets --ClusterIds '["c1c731554c1ec4a1ca9bb690ff9ed0000"]'
